newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dow Jones, Nikkei link for financial news services.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones, Nikkei link for financial news services.

text.p: Dow Jones and Co Inc said on Thursday that it had agreed on a broad strategic alliance with Japan's Nihon Keizai Shimbun Inc (Nikkei) and Quick Corp that includes the joint creation of new electronic financial news services for equities.
Nikkei is Japan's major business daily and Quick is an electronic media firm in the Nikkei group which provides financial news and market information in Japan and Asia, Dow Jones said in a statement.
The three parties will also exchange real-time, historical and fundamental data from around the world and plan to collaborate on future business initiatives, Dow Jones said.
Quick was quoted as saying in the Dow Jones' statement that it would further enhance the relationship with Dow Jones in the future.
The first jointly produced products will be released as early as September, Dow Jones said.

Under the alliance, Nikkei/Quick and Dow Jones will combine their newsroom operations in Japan under joint editorial direction, it said. The combined newsroom will produce a news service, both in English and Japanese, covering the Japanese financial markets focusing on equities, it said,

Services and shared data from the alliance will be offered through Nikkei/Quick and Dow Jones/Kyodo services in and outside Japan, Dow Jones said. KK Kyodo News is a business arm of Japanese news agency Kyodo.
